features: 【Ergonomic Design】 Our mid back mesh task chair has excellent elasticity, completely suitable for the waist and back curve. 【Easy to Install】The office chair contains the screws, tool and manual needed for installation. It will be a breeze to follow the installation steps and get an office chair that allows you to work comfortably within 10-15 minutes. If you have any questions, feel free to contact our customer service.

items.title: ANECDOTE. Lined Journal Notebook. Hard Cover, Ruled, Thick 100 gsm Paper, A5 size: 8.3 inches x 5.4 inches. Use for School, Office, Home or Business. (Ink Blue)
features: Feel The Difference: We make our hard covered notebooks & journals ruled or journals lined using only best in materials, starting with high quality cream (100gsm) thick paper, a special binding technology, all the way to the premium buckram cloth cover material. Colors of any Anecdote journal for women & men are handpicked. We want you to feel the care we put into every Anecdote notebook, and feel special whether using it as a daily journal, small notebook, daily diary or anything else!

Your Companion In Life: A writing journal small enough to take anywhere: it can become your best friend. Have you ever scrambled for napkins when a great idea hit you? Noted something down in a college ruled notebook or work notebook only to never find it again? You can take a hard cover notebook on adventures unlike a spiral bound journal, use it when traveling, at school, note down recipes, thoughts or to track anything you wish to, from emotions, visions, ideas & people you meet!

200 Pages Hardcover Lay Flat Design, Bookmark, Inner Pocket & Elastic Closure: We are committed to providing not only the best feel for our lined notebook but the most practical features as well. This durable thick paper notebook comes with a lay flat journal design for writing ease on a variety of surfaces. The inner pocket is large enough for business cards & notes, while the bookmark makes it easy to find your spot. Our lay flat notebook lasts 25% longer than a 160 page A5 journal.

Opens Endless Possibilities: For most, small notebooks is a preference (more versatile than a large notebook). Our premium business journal is a giftable business notebook for women, and a perfect bujo journal or office notebook. We have colors fitting business notebook for men too, and it is a great daily log book as well. For doodling or sketches we might suggest a blank journal for women & men, but for pretty much anything else you will find our lined journal notebook to be the better choice!

The Anecdote Approach: We believe that getting ideas out of one's head is both therapeutic and crucial in problem solving. Our mission is to bring high quality notebooks, planners and other tools to everyone in order to do just that. Be it bullet journaling, note taking, keeping track of ideas, for inspiration or motivation, our products will meet the many different needs. We make our thick journal for writing, hardback notebook and all writing journals with lined paper with the mission in mind!
